Sign catalogue

Sign

M99

Looks like: two short vertical strokes

Adapted from the field-cady sign descriptions (Parpola 122). This describes the picture, not the meaning: a sign that looks like a fish may stand for a sound or another word.

Wells W002 · Connective

Appears in 546 texts (649 uses), mostly on seals at Mohenjo-daro; usually sits inside a text. In the larger ICIT corpus its Wells equivalent W002 is in 723 texts, including at Dholavira.

Project finding: Validated connective: follows an opener Held up
